# Retained process-validation regression inputs

These 36 files are byte-exact copies of existing local campaign outputs. The
manifest records each original repository-relative path, length and SHA-256.
They make the jig, water-heater and staged heat-evidence regressions reproducible
in a clean checkout. No campaign is resumed, reviewed or granted new credit.

The tests copy inputs into fresh isolated workspaces and retain their original
geometry, measurements, source-identity and corruption checks. Their synthetic
automated profiles do not confer human review, dispatch or physical acceptance.
Captured bytes are protected from checkout normalization by `.gitattributes`.
